			<article class="fl-post post-204941 page type-page status-publish has-post-thumbnail hentry" id="fl-post-204941" itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork">
			<div class="fl-post-content clearfix" itemprop="text">

<div class="et_pb_text_inner">
<p>Located on the north shore of the Dominican Republic, Cabarete is a watersports lover’s dream. Windsurfers have been coming here since the 80s, but kiteboarding, surfing, and standup paddleboarding soon followed. Perfectly situated in the middle of Kite Beach, <a href="https://cabaretekitepoint.com/wind-season-cabarete/">the constant trade winds</a>, warm waters, and good vibes make <a href="https://cabaretekitepoint.com/kite/">Cabarete Kite Point Kiteboarding School</a> the perfect place to learn to kitesurf.</p>
<p>Besides having the perfect location, we also have a delicious restaurant with a killer view and a cozy hotel just steps from the ocean. So we decided, what the heck! Let's make a package deal that makes everyone's life easier. Wepa! And with that sentiment, our <strong>7-day all-inclusive Caribbean kite package</strong> deal was born</p>
<p>Now you can leave your wetsuit and your worries at home. But don’t forget to pack your stoke! We are about to show you why we have the best kite school in the Dominican Republic.</p>

When you book our package you will stay 7 nights in one of our standard beachfront rooms.  Each room comes with a wide-open view of the ocean, WIFI, and cleaning service included. We are positioned directly in the center of <a href="https://cabaretekitepoint.com/kite-beach-cabarete/">Kite Beach</a> just a few steps from the warm ocean water.</p>		</div>
